notes.title: News #1
notes.content:
[i][b]Greetings to all fans of political strategy games![/b][/i]

I'm excited to announce the launch of the official [i]Discord [/i] channel dedicated to the game, where you can ask the developer questions and get the latest updates on the development process. There's also a YouTube channel now live with the first teaser!

Starting this month, I’ll be hosting live development streams where you’ll have the chance to chat with me in real time, ask any questions you might have, and see how the game is progressing.

Join the community and stay tuned for updates — I’ll be happy to answer any questions you have!

[list]
[*] Discord: https://discord.gg/ePNRxkQXUf
[*] X: https://x.com/rasputie1992
[/list]
